text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hau~, what a bummer.
If it didn't work out, that means~...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So your love for Curren
was only worth that much, Big Brother...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So that was all your love for Curren amounted to,
Big Sis...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ufu, just kidding♪ I know you did your best in your own way, Onii-chan.
So...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ufu, just kidding♪ I know you did your best in your own way, Onee-chan.
So...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Love Curren eveeeen more,
and make Curren even cuter with your own hands, okay, Big Brother?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Love Curren eveeeen more,
and make Curren even cuter with your own hands, okay, Big Sister?
It ended in a disappointing result...
